params.message:
A partner's update for a deleted car creates the car again

A partner keeps the id of a car after the dealer deleted it and updates that id when the car returns to its feed. A regular partner's update became a proposal on a car nobody sees, a premium partner heard "no vehicle found", and the car never came in. Such an update for a deleted car of the caller's own dealer now runs through the create path and answers with the new car; the old row stays deleted.

Portal: Een wagen die in Stocklist verwijderd werd en later opnieuw via een partner binnenkomt, wordt nu opnieuw aangemaakt in plaats van stil weg te blijven.
